input.rationale: Paragraph 18 locks every Party, including us, into a twenty-five (25) year Initial Period with no unilateral exit: termination of participation is only available "at the end of the Initial Period or any time thereafter" on one year's notice (18.1), and mid-term termination requires unanimous written agreement of all Parties (18.2). Paragraph 22.1 further bars any transfer of our interest except with Management Committee consent, so there is no practical exit route either. That is squarely the playbook walk-away case — no Customer convenience right in a multi-year term — and it is compounded by the forfeiture in 18.5 ("No credit for capital costs will be made to a Party that terminates its participation in accordance with Subparagraph 18.1"), which is an uncapped exit penalty far exceeding the fallback cap of three months' fees. There is no Vendor-side convenience right to delete, since the regime is symmetric among the APCN 2 Parties. Given the consortium construction-and-maintenance bargain (shared capital assets and continuing Terminal Station obligations), a 30-day preferred exit would be disproportionate, so we redline to the fallback: a 90 days' notice convenience right, accrued liabilities preserved, and any further exit charge capped at three months' O&M share with no capital-cost forfeiture.

proposal.summary: Add a Party right to terminate participation for convenience during the Initial Period on 90 days' notice, with exit charge capped and no capital-cost forfeiture.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The 25-year Initial Period currently gives us no exit except unanimous agreement, and Subparagraph 18.5 forfeits our capital-cost credit on exit. We have added a convenience termination right on ninety (90) days' notice with the exit charge capped at three months' O&M share, which is our fallback position; we would accept 30 days' notice with a pro-rata credit as our preferred alternative.

ops.text: Notwithstanding Subparagraphs 18.1 and 18.2, any Party may terminate its participation in this Agreement for convenience, including at any time during the Initial Period, by giving not less than ninety (90) days' prior notice, in writing, to the other Parties. Such Party shall remain liable for its share of APCN 2 Capital Costs and Operation and Maintenance Costs accrued to the effective date of such termination, and any further charge payable by it by reason of such termination shall not exceed three (3) months of its share of Operation and Maintenance Costs. The exclusion of credit for capital costs in Subparagraph 18.5 shall not apply to a termination under this Subparagraph 18.2A.
